run_fairchem_cli: run the fairchem CLI with a YAML config file using the main entry point
load_hydra_config_from_yaml: load and parse a Hydra config from a YAML file with CLI override arguments
canonicalize_omegaconf_config: canonicalize an OmegaConf DictConfig by resolving variables and removing unused top-level keys
launch_job_on_slurm: launch a fairchem job on a SLURM cluster with optional Ray support
launch_job_locally: launch a fairchem job locally with optional Ray cluster or torch elastic mode
